name: Wei Jian Tan
bio:
Wei Jian discovered his passion for motorsport during his polytechnic days, captivated by the intricate electrical systems powering Formula SAE cars. After graduating from the National University of Singapore with a degree in Electrical Engineering, he honed his skills in the aerospace industry before transitioning to motorsport. He believes in a meticulous and data-driven approach to electronics, always seeking to optimize performance through precise calibration and innovative solutions.

His experience in both aerospace and motorsport gives him a unique perspective. Wei Jian is known for his ability to diagnose and resolve complex electrical issues quickly and efficiently. He thrives under pressure and is committed to pushing the boundaries of what's possible in racing electronics. He is a valuable addition to any race team looking to maximize the performance and reliability of their electrical systems.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part.
physical.description: Wei Jian is of average height, with a focused and intelligent gaze.
